profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. According to its own site, the company builds lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and says its sensors serve as the eyes of intelligent vehicles by providing high-resolution 3D perception. It states that it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, and that it has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries.

The site describes lidar as enabling features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking), NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and advanced semi-autonomous driving. For autonomous vehicles including robotaxis and robobuses, Hesai says it offers a range of high-performance lidar sensors that meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, aimed at large-scale deployment of autonomous fleets. It also positions its sensors for trucking, industrial applications, and next-generation robotics.

The company is registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001861737. No litigation involving the company is recorded.
